title: The Surprising Origins of Native Hawaiians - Nautilus
gist: A Science Advances genetic study led in part by Stanford's Alexander Ioannidis better defines the ancestry of Native Hawaiians within the Polynesian diaspora.

insights.claim: A new Science Advances study better defines the genetic history of Native Hawaiians and where they came from; Hawaii is the only Polynesian island in the Northern Hemisphere.
insights.speaker: Jake Currie
insights.so_what: Genetic evidence refines models of Polynesian settlement.
insights.locator: What we uncover in this paper

insights.claim: Polynesian voyagers colonized small South Pacific islands without metal tools, navigational equipment or a written language, while Europe was still in the Middle Ages.
insights.speaker: Jake Currie
insights.so_what: Context on the scale of Polynesian exploration.
